description: Update an issue. Slim confirmation by default; full_response=true for the complete object. Change fields on an existing issue. Use `update_issue_description_patch` for a targeted description edit and `create_issue_note` for discussion.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.
